a.m: The morning half of the day: Present, Absent, Sick, Medical, Sunday, Holiday, Leave ... Each half counts as half a day on the salary card. Picked on daily attendance.
absent: Workers (or days) marked Absent on the attendance grid. An absent day is not paid and also costs a day's deduction on a daily-wage card. Counted from the grid.
access|can open: The pages and tabs this login can open. Comes from its role or its own ticked rights.
access|full name: The person's name. Shown on screens and reports.
access|login: The username a person signs in with, with their full name under it. Set when the login is made.
access|notes: What a person with this role does. For reference only.
access|password: The login's password, at least 6 characters. Typed when the login is made.
access|role: The role that gives this login its rights. Admin needs none; Custom rights means ticked one by one.
access|role name: The name of the role (e.g. Store keeper).
access|status: Active, or Off (cannot sign in). Switched on the login.
access|type: Admin (everything), Office or Site login. Set when the login is made.
access|username: The name typed to sign in. Must be unique.
access|username (to sign in): The name typed to sign in. Changing your own means signing in again.
adjusted final salary: What the worker is actually paid this cycle: final salary plus additions minus deductions entered on Salary Adjustments. Worked out by the app.
adjustments: Additions and deductions typed for this worker this cycle (fines, advances, extra allowance), each with its reason. They change what he is paid on top of the card. Entered on Salary Adjustments.
aed: The amount in UAE dirhams for each line above. The totals at the foot add these up.
afternoon: What the worker was marked for the afternoon half (Present, Absent, Sick ...). Read from the daily attendance grid for this date.
already in: What has already arrived against this request line in earlier deliveries. Comes from the deliveries recorded before.
amount: The money on this line, in AED. Typed when the entry is made.
amount (aed): The money paid, in AED. Typed when the payment is entered.
approvals|arrived: How much has been received so far against this line. Comes from the deliveries recorded.
approvals|asked by: Who raised the request (site engineer or store keeper). He is the contact on the order unless changed.
approvals|asked on: The day the request was raised. Recorded by the app when it is sent.
approvals|date: The day this delivery arrived. Stock is booked on this date. Entered with Record what arrived.
approvals|do / invoice: The delivery order or invoice number from the supplier's paper. Lets the office match the bill. Typed when the delivery is recorded.
approvals|material: The material on the request line, as named on the store item list. Picked by whoever raised the request.
approvals|materials: What is asked for, with quantities. Open the row for each line's arrivals and supplier.
approvals|needed by: The date the site needs it. Past this date and not delivered, the request shows as late.
approvals|ordered from: The supplier this line was ordered from. Set with Mark as ordered.
approvals|recorded by: The login that recorded the delivery. Saved by the app.
approvals|request: The request number (e.g. MR-0123). Click the row to see its materials and what has arrived.
approvals|site: The site the materials are for. Its plot and in-charge go onto the order.
approvals|status: Waiting on office, Office approved, Ordered from supplier, Part delivered, Delivered, Closed or Rejected. Moves on as the office approves, orders and the store receives.
approvals|still to come: Asked for minus arrived. Worked out by the app.
approvals|supplier: Who delivered the load. Picked when the delivery is recorded.
approvals|taken in to: Where the load went: the central store or straight to a site. It books the stock to that place. Picked as Delivered to.
approvals|this material: Actions for this one line (e.g. reject just this material) while the rest of the request carries on.
approvals|what it is for: The job the material is for. Becomes the job scope on the order. Typed on the request.
approvals|what you can do: The next step this login may take on the request: approve or reject, mark ordered, or record a delivery. Depends on its status and your rights.
area: The part of the app the change was made in (attendance, payroll, store ...). Recorded by the app automatically.
arrived now: How much came on this delivery. Filled in with what is still due; change it if the load came short, clear it if nothing came.
attendance|name: The worker's name from Labour master data. Everyone employed on this date is listed, from his joining day to his last working day.
attendance|site: The site (project code) the worker was at that day. Present needs a site and an engineer. Picked on the row, or for all ticked rows with Apply to Ticked; it remembers his last site.
bank|bank: Bank tick: the line is found on an uploaded ADCB statement. A dash means not on a statement yet.
bank|bills / invoices: The supplier bills or client invoices this payment settles (or the expense account). Picked so Zoho applies the payment to them.
bank|date: The day the money moved on the ADCB account (cheque date for a cheque). Typed from the statement.
bank|includes 5% vat?: For a client receipt: tick if the amount received includes 5% VAT. The amount excl. VAT booked on Project payments is then worked out as amount / 1.05; untick if no VAT.
bank|mode: How it was paid: bank transfer, cheque, credit card or cash. A cheque carries its date and number as the reference.
bank|paid out: Money going out of the account, in AED. Added up at the foot.
bank|paid to / received from: The supplier, subcontractor or client; for a transfer, the petty cash box it went to. The description and who entered it show under it.
bank|project: The site the expense is for, or the project scope a client receipt goes to (PP = amount booked on Project payments, excl. VAT).
bank|received: Money coming into the account, in AED. Added up at the foot.
bank|reference #: The ADCB reference from the statement (or cheque number). Used to match the line to the bank statement.
bank|type: Paid to supplier, Paid - expense, Received from client, Bank charge or Transfer. Decides what it becomes in Zoho (payment made, expense, customer payment, fees, transfer).
bank|vat on the bill?: For a direct expense: tick if the bill shows VAT. Then choose Claim 5% or Not claimable, and type the supplier's TRN to claim it.
bank|zoho: Whether the line is in Zoho Books yet. The chief accountant's entries go when saved; others wait for him to send.
bh: Holiday hours (BH) worked that day. Paid like OT at total salary / 30 / 8 an hour. Over 2 hours needs a comment. Typed on daily attendance.
can open: The pages and tabs this login can open, from its role or its own rights. Changed on Settings > Access.
cashreg|amount: The amount in AED. Received and paid out are totalled separately; the balance is received minus paid.
cashreg|current password: The register's present password. Needed to set a new one.
cashreg|date: The day the cash came in or went out. Picked when the line is added.
cashreg|description: What the cash was for or who it came from (e.g. Received from Mr. Ahmed - Plot 906).
cashreg|from: First day shown. Lines from this day are listed.
cashreg|remarks: A note on a cash payment. Optional.
cashreg|to: Last day shown. Lines up to this day are listed.
category: The group the item belongs to. Used to sort and filter the list. Picked or typed on the record.
code: The person's or item's code in the app (e.g. F-782 for a worker, the item code for a material). It links the line to its record. Given when the record is first added.
combine|absent: Days marked Absent in that cycle. Absent and leave days are taken out of the service counted for gratuity. Counted from the attendance grid.
combine|adjustments: Every addition and deduction typed for this worker this cycle, with its reason. Added below the list for the selected worker.
combine|allowance: The allowance part of the salary after this change (salary minus basic). A rise goes here by house rule. Worked out from the line, or typed when correcting it.
combine|basic: The worker's basic after this change. By house rule a rise goes onto the allowance and the basic stays. Worked out from the line, or typed when correcting it.
combine|change: What kind of line this is: Joined (starting rate), Increment, or Correction. Set by how the line was recorded.
combine|code: The worker's employee number. Links the line to his Labour master data record.
combine|cycle: The payroll cycle (26th to 25th, named by its ending month) the absence or leave fell in. One line per cycle with any absence.
combine|date(s): The first and last day of absence or leave in that cycle. Read from the daily attendance grid.
combine|from: The date the new rate applies from. Cycles before it keep the rate they were paid at. Picked when the increment is recorded (this cycle or the last).
combine|increase: How much the monthly salary went up with this line. Typed when the increment is recorded.
combine|leave: Days marked Leave in that cycle. Absent and leave days are taken out of the service counted for gratuity. Counted from the attendance grid.
combine|name: The worker's name. Click a row to see or add his adjustments for the cycle.
combine|reason: Why the rate changed (e.g. good work, new rate). Prints on the salary history. Typed when the increment is recorded.
combine|salary: The total monthly salary after this change: basic + allowance. This is the Total Salary the cards are worked on from that date.
comments: A free note for the day (why absent, why the extra hours). Over 2 BH hours needs a comment before the day can be saved. Typed on daily attendance.
company: Which company employs the person (Infinia or a sister company). Statements, reports and papers are split by it. Picked on the person's record.
contact: The person to deal with there. Prints on orders. Typed on the supplier record.
contact number: The supplier contact's phone number. Shows on follow-up so the office can chase the delivery. Fills in from the supplier list.
contact person: The person to call at the supplier. Prints on the order and shows on follow-up. Fills in from the supplier list; typed if new.
cycle: The payroll cycle: 26th of one month to 25th of the next, named by its ending month (October 2026 = 26 Sep to 25 Oct). Attendance, cards and reports are grouped by it.
date: The day the entry is for. Used to sort the list and to place it in the right month. Picked when the entry is made; it defaults to today.
days: Number of days for the line. Worked out from the dates, or typed where shown.
deductions: What comes off the final settlement: loan or advance balance, notice not served and other deductions. Worked out from the record plus the figures typed on the left.
delivery date: The day the load actually arrived. Stock is booked on this date. Picked when recording the delivery.
delivery note: The delivery note number on the supplier's paper. Lets the office match the paper to the bill. Typed by the store keeper on the transmittal.
The delivery note number on the supplier's paper. Lets the office match it to the bill. Typed by the store keeper.
description: What the entry is for, in plain words. It prints on the paper and is what a search finds. Typed when the entry is made.
designation: The person's job title or trade. Shows his role on lists and papers. Typed on his staff record.
details: The specifics of the change (which record, old and new figures). Recorded by the app automatically.
docsoffice|date: The day the papers were sent from site. Picked on the transmittal.
The number on the supplier's delivery note. Lets the office match it to the bill.
docsoffice|documents: How many papers, from which sites and suppliers. Open the line to see each one.
docsoffice|from site / project: The site or project the papers are sent from. Prints on the transmittal.
The transmittal number (DOF:005 on). Numbered by itself.
docsoffice|office: Waiting, Received (with who and when) or how many are missing. Set as the assistant accountant ticks each paper received.
docsoffice|remarks: Any note on the paper. Optional.
docsoffice|sent by: The login (store keeper) who sent the transmittal. Saved by the app.
docsoffice|site: The site the delivery was for. Picked on the line.
docsoffice|supplier: The supplier on the delivery note. Picked from the supplier list or typed.
document: Which document this is (passport, visa, Emirates ID, labour card, NOC, licence ...). Picked or typed when it is recorded.
documents: The papers listed on this transmittal (supplier and delivery note no.). The office ticks each one as it arrives.
email: The email address on the record. Used to send orders and papers. Typed on the record.
emp no: The worker's employee number (e.g. F-782). It ties his attendance, salary card and records together. Set on Labour master data when he is added and never reused.
engineer: The site engineer the worker reported to that day. Shows who can confirm the day. Picked on the daily attendance with the site.
errorcheck|name: The worker whose card is not ready. Tick to include him in the reminder sent to site.
expires: The expiry date on the document. Reminders and the standing are worked from it. Typed from the paper.
expiry|category: The group the company document belongs to (NOC, trade licence, vehicle, permit ...). Typed or picked when it is added.
expiry|code: The staff or labour code. Links the line to his People file.
expiry|document: Which document it is (passport, visa, Emirates ID, labour card, NOC, licence ...). Picked or typed when it is recorded.
expiry|document name: The name of a document that is not in the list (e.g. Safety card). Typed once; it is offered again next time.
expiry|emirates id: Expiry date of his Emirates ID, coloured by how soon it falls due. From his documents on file.
expiry|expires: The expiry date on the document, with how many days are left. Reminders go 90, 30, 14, 7, 3 and 1 days before, on the day and after. Typed from the paper.
expiry|for: Whose document it is: Staff, Labour, or the company (vehicle, licence, NOC ...). Shows which list it is kept on.
expiry|item: What the document is for (e.g. Villa 347 Sobha Hartland, the pickup). Typed when it is added.
expiry|name: The staff member or worker. Click the line to renew or correct his documents.
expiry|name / item: The person (with his code) or the company item the document belongs to. Click the line to renew or correct it.
expiry|notes: Any remark kept with the document. Optional.
expiry|number: The document's number, from the paper. Optional.
expiry|other: Any other documents on his file (safety card, driving licence ...) with their expiry. Recorded on his documents.
expiry|passport: Expiry date of his passport, coloured by how soon it falls due. From his documents on file.
expiry|standing: Expired, Due in 30 days, Due in 90 days or Valid - worked out from the expiry date against today. For a person, the worst of his documents.
expiry|visa / labour card: Expiry date of his residence visa or labour card, coloured by how soon it falls due. From his documents on file.
final salary: The salary card's result for the cycle before manual adjustments: payable salary + OT + BH + allowances - absence deduction, rounded to whole dirhams. Worked out from the attendance.
followup|expected: The delivery date the supplier promised. Typed with Mark as ordered.
followup|for site: The site the material is for. Filter by it to see one site's deliveries.
followup|material: The material still to arrive. One line per material on an open request.
followup|needed by: When the site needs it. Past this date the line is late.
followup|ordered from: The supplier it was ordered from, set with Mark as ordered. Blank = not ordered yet.
followup|request: The material request it belongs to. Click to open it.
followup|status: Late (past needed by or expected), on order, or not ordered yet. Worked out from the dates and whether a supplier is set.
followup|still due: Asked for minus already received. Worked out by the app.
followup|who to call: The supplier's contact person and phone, to chase the delivery. From the order or the supplier list.
for: What the line is for. Picked or typed when the entry is made.
from: The supplier this material came from on this delivery. Kept on the line so each material remembers its own supplier. Filled in from the order; change it if another supplier delivered.
half day: Workers present for one half of the day only. Counted from the daily attendance grid (A.M and P.M differ).
how many: The quantity, in the material's unit. Typed with the material.
Unpaid days this month x gross / 30 (whole dirhams; half day = half), plus days before joining or after leaving. Never more than the month's gross. From the Absence register; can be typed over.
Everything on Additions & Deductions for this month in one figure: additions + leave salary + air ticket - deductions. The remark says what made it up. Click to open that tab.
hrpayroll|addition: The amount added to that month's salary (taxi bill, fee paid for him, leave salary, ticket ...). Typed on Additions & Deductions.
hrpayroll|allowance: The allowance part of the salary after this change. By house rule a rise goes onto the allowance and the basic stays.
hrpayroll|amount: The amount repaid on the loan. Typed when a repayment is entered.
hrpayroll|balance: Still owed on the loan: lent minus recovered. The loan shows closed once nothing is left.
hrpayroll|basic: Basic salary for the month, as it stood that month (increments apply from their date). Gratuity is worked on basic. Comes from the staff record and Increments.
hrpayroll|change: What the line is: Joined (starting salary), Increment, or Correction. Set by how it was recorded.
hrpayroll|code: The staff member's code (e.g. IC-012). Links the line to his staff record.
hrpayroll|company: Which company employs him and whose statement he is on. Picked on the staff record.
hrpayroll|date: The day the repayment was made. Salary instalments carry the cycle's date.
hrpayroll|date(s): The day or days away. A range is one entry; Half day counts 0.5. Picked when the absence is recorded.
hrpayroll|days: How many days the entry covers (in this month, where it runs into another). Half day shows as Half.
hrpayroll|deduction: On Absence: what the unpaid days cost - days x gross / 30, whole dirhams. On Additions & Deductions: the amount taken off the salary for that month.
hrpayroll|designation: His job title, as it prints on the statement. Typed on the staff record.
hrpayroll|employee: The staff member on this statement. A Bank or Cash tag shows he is not paid through WPS. Click the name to open his record.
Fixed allowance for the month (gross minus basic). By house rule rises go here. Comes from the staff record and Increments.
hrpayroll|for: What the addition or deduction is for (taxi, ILOE, fine, advance, leave salary ...). Picked when it is entered; the note prints as the remark.
hrpayroll|from: The date the salary line applies from. A rise dated ahead waits for its month. Picked when the increment is recorded.
hrpayroll|full name: His full name as it prints on statements and papers. Typed when the staff member is added.
hrpayroll|gross: Monthly gross salary: basic + fixed allowance. A day's pay is gross / 30, dropped to whole dirhams.
hrpayroll|how: How the money came back: from salary, cash, bank transfer, final settlement, or before the app. Salary instalments are recorded when the cycle is approved.
hrpayroll|increase: How much the monthly gross went up. Typed when the increment is recorded.
hrpayroll|joined: His joining date. Service, leave and gratuity are counted from it. Typed on the staff record.
hrpayroll|joining date: The day he started. Service, leave and gratuity are counted from it, and a first month is part-paid from this day.
hrpayroll|leave salary: Leave salary paid for the vacation (offered at a month's gross once a year is served). Paid with the salary of the month chosen. Typed with the vacation.
hrpayroll|lent: The amount lent. Typed when the loan is recorded.
hrpayroll|loan: Loan instalment taken this month: the monthly amount set on his running loans, never more than is left. Type over it to take a different amount. Approving the cycle records it as repaid.
hrpayroll|monthly: The instalment taken from salary each month (0 = not from salary). The salary cycle proposes this, never more than is left.
hrpayroll|name: The staff member's name. Click it to open his staff record.
hrpayroll|net pay: What he is paid: basic + allowance - absent deduction + additions - deductions - loan + leave salary + air ticket. Pension is shown beside it, not added. Worked out, never typed.
hrpayroll|note: A short note on the entry. On Additions & Deductions it prints as the remark on the statement.
hrpayroll|paid by: How the salary is paid: WPS, bank transfer or cash. The salary sheet totals each route separately. Set on the staff record.
hrpayroll|pay: On the salary sheet: ticked = paid this month; untick to hold the salary over. On absence lists: whether the day is paid or deducted - one sick day a month is paid, absent, unpaid and vacation days are deducted, unless set by hand.
hrpayroll|pension: GPSSA pension for nationals, per month. Printed in its own column and never added into net pay. Set on the staff record.
hrpayroll|reason: Why the salary changed (e.g. annual increment). Prints on the salary history.
hrpayroll|recovered: How much of the loan has come back. Instalments from approved salary cycles plus repayments entered by hand.
hrpayroll|remark: Prints on the statement against the line. Filled by itself from the registers (additions, loan and balance, absent days); type over it to say something else.
hrpayroll|salary: Monthly gross after this change: basic + allowance. Used on every salary cycle from that date.
hrpayroll|salary to date: While the month is still running: what he has earned up to today. The full-month figure to pay shows in the totals below.
hrpayroll|service: How long he has worked, in years and months. Used for leave salary and gratuity. Counted from joining date to today (or his last day).
hrpayroll|staff: The staff member the entry is for. Picked from the office and local staff list.
hrpayroll|staff member: The staff member whose gratuity and final settlement are shown. People who have left are listed at the end.
hrpayroll|taken on: The day the loan was given. Typed when the loan is recorded.
hrpayroll|terms: The repayment terms as agreed (e.g. 500 a month from November). For reference; typed with the loan.
hrpayroll|ticket: Air ticket amount paid with the vacation. Typed with the vacation entry.
hrpayroll|type: The kind of absence: Absent, Sick, Annual vacation, Unpaid leave, Company holiday / day off or Paid leave. Decides whether the day is paid. Picked when it is recorded.
invoices|client: Who the invoice is addressed to. Their TRN and address fill in from earlier invoices.
invoices|date: The invoice date. Prints on the invoice.
invoices|description: What is being billed (e.g. 2nd progress payment). Prints on the invoice line.
invoices|net: The invoice amount before VAT. Its lines added up.
invoices|net amount (aed): The line amount before VAT. Typed from the agreed figure.
invoices|number: The invoice number. Filled in with the next one; type over it if needed.
invoices|project: The project the invoice is for (project no. and description).
invoices|total: What the client pays. Net + VAT.
invoices|total (aed): What the line comes to with VAT. Net amount + VAT.
invoices|vat: The VAT rate on the line (5% or 0%). On the list: the invoice's VAT in AED.
invoices|vat (aed): VAT on the line. Net amount x VAT rate.
item: The item or document the line is about. Typed or picked when the entry is made.
last site: The last site this worker was marked at before this date. Helps find who to ask for a missing day. Read from earlier attendance.
leave: Workers (or days) marked Leave on the attendance grid. Leave is unpaid on a daily wage and taken off a fixed salary at 1/30 a day. Counted from the grid.
lines: How many material lines are on it. Counted by the app.
livecard|date: The day of the cycle (26th to 25th). One line per day of this worker's salary card.
livecard|name: The worker's name. Click a worker to open his salary card for the cycle.
livecard|site: The site he was marked at that day. Shows where his days were spent. From the daily attendance.
login: The username a person signs in with, with their full name under it. Set when the login is made.
lporegister|columns: The figures to show for each line (orders, materials, quantity, sub total, VAT, total). Tick what you need.
lporegister|date: The order date. Filter the register by From / To on it.
lporegister|each order: The LPO number. Click it to open the order.
lporegister|job scope: The job scope written on the orders. Group by it for spend per job.
lporegister|material: The material bought. Click to see every order for it.
lporegister|materials: How many material lines those orders carry. Counted from the orders.
lporegister|month: The month the orders were dated. Group by it for spend per month.
lporegister|orders: How many orders fall in the line. Cancelled orders are left out.
lporegister|project location: The site the order was for. Click to see only that site's orders. Taken from the order's project location.
lporegister|quantity: Total quantity ordered in the line. Added up from the order lines.
lporegister|sub total (aed): What the goods cost before VAT. Qty x rate added up, less any discount.
lporegister|supplier: Who the order went to. Click to see only that supplier's orders.
lporegister|total (aed): What the orders come to with VAT. Sub total + VAT.
lporegister|vat (aed): VAT on those orders. Each line's tax %, or 5% of the net when a discount was given.
masterdata|basic salary: The basic part of his monthly salary. Gratuity is worked on basic; the rest of total salary is allowance. Typed here.
masterdata|code: The site code (project number, e.g. 704). Used on attendance, requests, orders and costs. Typed when the site is added.
masterdata|company: Which company employs him. Reports and salary cards are split by company. Picked here.
masterdata|mobile: The engineer's mobile. It prints on purchase orders raised from his requests. Typed here.
masterdata|name: The engineer's or worker's name as it shows on attendance and orders. Typed here.
masterdata|pay type: Daily wage: paid per day worked; an absence costs the day plus a day's deduction. Fixed monthly: the whole salary, less 1/30 per absent or leave day. Picked here.
masterdata|status: Active, or the last working day if he has left. He stays on that cycle's cards and drops off from the next one. Set with Last working day.
masterdata|total salary: His full monthly salary (basic + allowance). A day is total salary / 30, an OT or BH hour is that / 8. Typed here; a change applies from this cycle or the last one.
masterdata|trade: The worker's trade (mason, carpenter, helper ...). Prints on his card and groups reports. Typed here.
material: The material or tool, as named on the store item list. Keeps stock and prices on one name. Picked from the item list (or typed if new).
materials: The materials on this request or order. Each is picked from the store item list with its quantity.
medical: Workers marked Medical for the day. Medical days are paid on the labour salary card. Counted from the daily attendance grid.
month: The month the figures belong to. Payroll cycles are named by their ending month.
monthly|absence deduction (aed): What absence cost him this cycle. Daily wage: absent days x total salary / 30. Fixed pay: (absent + leave days) x total salary / 30.
monthly|absent days: Days absent on the salary card for the cycle. Each costs the day and a day's deduction (daily wage). Counted from the grid.
monthly|adjusted final salary (aed): What the worker is paid. Final salary plus additions minus deductions from Salary Adjustments.
monthly|adjustments: Additions and deductions for the cycle, each with its reason, in one column. Typed on Salary Adjustments.
monthly|adjustments & notes: This month's adjustments for the worker, and a note for management typed beneath. The note saves as you leave the box and comes back with the cycle.
monthly|basic pay (aed): The basic pay on the worker's salary card for the cycle. Comes from his basic salary on Labour master data.
monthly|bh amount (aed): Holiday-hours money for the group. Worked out per worker at his own rate: total salary / 30 / 8 x BH hours.
monthly|bh hours: Holiday (BH) hours added up from the attendance (or the salary cards). Paid at total salary / 30 / 8 an hour.
monthly|company: The company that employs the worker. Group by it to split figures by company. From Labour master data.
monthly|date: The attendance date. Group by it for a day-by-day view.
monthly|days absent: Days marked Absent in the group; each half day counts 0.5. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|days friday: Days marked Friday (the old rest day) in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|days holiday: Days marked Holiday (paid) in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|days leave: Days marked Leave in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|days medical: Days marked Medical in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|days present: Days marked Present in the group; each half day counts 0.5. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|days sick: Days marked Sick in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|days sunday: Days marked Sunday (paid rest day) in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|employee name: The worker's name. Pick it to get one line per worker. From Labour master data.
monthly|employee no: The worker's employee number. Pick it to get one line per worker.
monthly|engineer: The site engineer the days were logged under. Group by it to see each engineer's men. From daily attendance.
monthly|final salary (aed): Payable salary + OT + BH + allowances - absence deduction, rounded to whole dirhams. Before manual adjustments.
monthly|final salary cost (aed): Each worker's final salary for the cycle, shared over the sites and days in this group by his share of paid days. Shows labour cost per site.
monthly|friday days: Days marked Friday (the rest day on older cycles). Paid. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|headcount: How many different workers are in the group. Counted by the app.
monthly|holiday days: Public or company holidays on the salary card. Paid. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|leave days: Days marked Leave on the salary card. Unpaid on a daily wage; 1/30 off a fixed salary. Counted from the grid.
monthly|man-days: How many attendance rows (one per worker per day) are in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|medical days: Days marked Medical on the salary card. Paid like a working day. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|month: The payroll cycle (26th to 25th), named by its ending month. Group by it for month-by-month figures.
monthly|ot amount (aed): Overtime money for the group. Worked out per worker at his own rate: total salary / 30 / 8 x OT hours.
monthly|ot hours: Overtime hours added up from the attendance (or the salary cards). Paid at total salary / 30 / 8 an hour.
monthly|payable salary (aed): The part of his salary earned for the paid days: (present + sick + medical + Friday + Sunday + holiday days) x total salary / 30. Fixed pay is capped at the salary.
monthly|present days: Days present on the salary card for the cycle. Half days count 0.5. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|sick days: Days marked Sick on the salary card. Paid like a working day. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|site: The site the days were logged to on daily attendance. Group by it to see work and cost per project.
monthly|sunday days: Sundays on the salary card. A paid rest day. Counted from the attendance grid.
monthly|total salary (aed): The worker's monthly salary from Labour master data (basic + allowance). Not what he is paid this cycle.
monthly|trade: The worker's trade. Group by it to compare trades. From Labour master data.
morning: What the worker was marked for the morning half (Present, Absent, Sick ...). Read from the daily attendance grid for this date.
name: The name as kept on the record. Shows whose or which line this is. Typed when the record is added and changed on the record itself.
The line or document number. Transmittals number themselves (DOF:005 onward).
note: A short free note on the line. Prints with it. Typed by whoever makes the entry; optional.
notes: Any free remark kept with the entry. Prints with it. Typed by whoever makes the entry; optional.
number: The document's own number (passport, Emirates ID, permit, invoice no.). Typed from the paper.
off: Workers on a paid day off (Sunday or Holiday) that day. Counted from the daily attendance grid.
ordered: The quantity asked for on the request. The arrival is checked against it. Comes from the material request.
ot: Overtime hours worked that day. Paid on the salary card at the hourly rate: total salary / 30 / 8 x OT hours. Typed on daily attendance.
ot hrs: Overtime hours added up for the line. Taken from the OT typed on the daily attendance (or the salary card for the month).
p.m: The afternoon half of the day: Present, Absent, Sick, Medical, Sunday, Holiday, Leave ... Each half counts as half a day on the salary card. Picked on daily attendance.
payable: What is owed to the person on final settlement: gratuity, unused leave, unpaid salary, ticket and other additions. Worked out from the record plus the figures typed on the left.
pdc|amount: The cheque amount in AED. Added up by payee and month in the grid.
pdc|bank: The bank account the cheque is drawn on. Typed from the cheque book.
pdc|cheque date: The date the cheque can be presented. 'Date to fill' means the month is known but not the day.
pdc|cheque no: The cheque number. Typed from the cheque book.
pdc|for / notes: What the cheque pays for, or any note. Typed when the cheque is added.
pdc|overdue: Cheques past their date and not yet marked cleared, added up per payee. Mark them cleared once the bank shows them.
pdc|payee: Who the post-dated cheque was given to. The grid adds up each payee's cheques by month.
pdc|standing: Cleared, cancelled, no date yet, overdue (days past the cheque date), today, or in how many days. Reminders come 14 and 7 days before, on the day and after until cleared.
pdc|total: All the payee's cheques in the months shown (or the month's total at the foot). Added up by the app.
people|absent: Absence deduction on that statement (staff) or days absent on the card (labour). From the payroll.
people|accommodation: Where he lives (camp or building). Typed on his file.
people|accrued: Leave earned so far. Opening balance + days per period x months served / months in the period.
Additions minus deductions on that month's statement. From Additions & Deductions.
people|allowance: Allowance from that date. Gross minus basic.
people|amount: The amount lent (or repaid). Typed when the loan or repayment is recorded.
people|approved by: Who approved the leave. Typed when it is approved.
people|balance: Leave: accrued minus taken, in days. Loans: amount lent minus recovered.
people|basic: Basic salary from that date. Gratuity is worked on basic.
people|birthday: The date of the next birthday. From the date of birth on file.
people|blood group: His blood group. Kept for emergencies. Typed on his file.
people|change: How much the monthly rate went up or down. New rate minus the one before.
people|code: The person's staff or labour code. Links every register to his file.
people|code / project: The staff code, or the project number for a client. Shows whose birthday it is.
people|company: Which company employs him. Picked on his file.
people|condition: The state the item is in. Typed when it is issued or returned.
people|date of birth: The date of birth on file (as per passport for staff). Birthdays and age are worked from it.
people|date of birth (as per passport): His date of birth as on the passport. Birthdays are listed from it.
people|date of leave: The day he goes. Leave days and On leave count from it.
people|date of return: The day he is back, or due back (date of leave + approved days). Past it and not returned, he shows Overdue.
people|date(s): The day or days of absence. From the Absence register.
people|days: Due list: days left before the document expires. Leave lists: the days approved or taken. Worked out from the dates, or typed as approved days.
people|days left: Days until the document expires (red when 30 or less or expired, yellow up to 90). Worked out from the expiry date.
people|deduction: What the unpaid days cost. Days x gross / 30, whole dirhams.
people|designation: His job title or trade. Typed on his file.
people|document: Which document it is (passport, visa, Emirates ID, labour card ...). Recorded on his file.
people|effective: The date the salary applies from. Salary cycles from this date use it.
people|emergency contact: Who to call in an emergency. Typed on his file.
people|employment type: Limited contract, unlimited contract or part-time. Used for end-of-service rules.
people|end of service: What he is owed on leaving: gratuity (UAE law), GPSSA pension for nationals, or not entitled. Picked on his file.
people|expires: The expiry date on the document. The days left are worked out from it.
people|from: The day the leave spell (or the new rate) starts. From the leave taken or the rate change.
people|gender: Male or female. Picked on his file.
people|gross: Monthly gross on that statement. Basic + allowance.
people|home contact: His phone number in his home country while on leave. Typed with the leave.
people|home-country address: His address in his home country. Typed on his file.
people|in: How many days until the birthday (Today, Tomorrow, or days). Worked out from today.
people|issued: The issue date on the document or item. Typed from the paper.
people|item: What was issued to him (laptop, SIM, helmet ...). Recorded so it can be collected back.
people|joined: His joining date. Leave and service are counted from it (or from the opening balance date).
people|joining date: The day he started. Service, leave and gratuity are counted from it.
people|kind: Joined, increment or correction. Set by how the line was recorded.
people|last vacation: The most recent leave spell, with its days. From the leave taken.
people|leave: Days marked Leave on the labour salary card. Counted from the attendance grid.
people|leave type: Annual, sick, emergency, unpaid leave ... Annual and emergency leave come off the leave balance.
people|leaving reason: Why he left (resignation, termination, end of contract ...). Typed on his file.
people|loan: Loan instalment taken that month. From the salary statement.
people|marital status: Single or married. Picked on his file.
people|month: The salary month (staff) or payroll cycle (labour). One line per statement or card.
people|monthly: Monthly salary from that date. Basic + allowance.
people|monthly salary: The new monthly rate (basic + allowance). Cards from the From date are worked out on it.
people|name: The person's name as on the register (or the client's name for a client birthday). Open goes to his file.
people|nationality: His nationality, as per passport. Typed on his file.
people|net: What was paid that month. From the salary statement or card.
people|next due: When the next full block of leave falls due (a period after the last block used). Red when already due.
people|notes: Any remark kept with the entry. Optional.
people|number: The document's number. Typed from the paper.
people|ot hrs: Overtime hours on the labour salary card. Added up from the attendance.
people|paid by: How the salary is paid: WPS, bank transfer or cash. The salary sheet totals each route separately.
people|paid on: The day the repayment was made. Typed with the repayment.
people|pay: Whether the day was paid or deducted, and why. One sick day a month is paid; absent, unpaid and vacation days are deducted.
people|personal email: His own email address. Typed on his file.
people|present: Days present on the labour salary card. Counted from the attendance grid.
people|reason: Why the salary or rate changed. Typed with the change.
people|recovered: How much of the loan has come back. Salary instalments plus repayments entered.
people|register: Which register the person is on: Labour, Office staff or Local staff. Decides the pay, leave and document rules used.
people|rehire: Whether he may be taken on again. Picked when he leaves.
people|relation: How the contact is related to him (or to the company, for a client birthday). Typed on the record.
people|religion: His religion, as on file. Typed on his file.
people|remark: Any note on the leave. Typed with the leave.
people|reports to: His line manager. Typed on his file.
people|returned: The day the item came back. Blank = still with him.
people|room / bed: His room and bed in the accommodation. Typed on his file.
people|rule: His leave entitlement. Labour 60 days every 2 years; office and local staff 30 days a year, unless his contract sets other figures on his file.
people|service: How long he has worked. From joining date to today or his leaving date.
people|staff: The person on leave. Click a line to change it.
people|status: Leave: Pending, Approved, On leave, Overdue (past the return date) or Returned. Loans: Running or Closed. Salary cycles: Paid, Held or draft.
people|tag / serial: The asset tag or serial number. Identifies the exact item.
people|taken: Leave days used. Absence register vacations (staff) or days marked Leave on attendance (labour), plus approved annual and emergency leave.
people|taken on: The day the loan was given. Typed with the loan.
people|terms: The agreed repayment terms (e.g. 500 a month from October).
people|their phone: The emergency contact's phone number. Typed on his file.
people|to: The last day of the leave spell. From the leave taken.
people|transport: How he gets to work (company bus, own car ...). Typed on his file.
people|turns: The age the person turns on this birthday. Worked out from the date of birth.
people|type: The kind of absence (absent, sick, vacation, unpaid ...). Decides if the day is paid.
people|uae address: Where he lives in the UAE. Typed on his file.
people|what changed: What was changed on this person's record. From the app's change log.
people|when: When the change was made. Recorded by the app.
people|who: The login that made the change. Recorded by the app.
people|work email: His company email address. Typed on his file.
pettycash|balance (aed): What is left in the book after each line. Shows when a top-up is needed. Brought forward + received - paid, in date order.
pettycash|balance due (aed): What the company owes the director after each line. Paid by him minus repaid to him, in date order.
pettycash|cr - repaid to naveen (aed): What was paid back to Naveen. What the company owes him goes down.
pettycash|cr - repaid to praveen (aed): What was paid back to Praveen. What the company owes him goes down.
pettycash|date: The day the bill was paid or the cash was received. The balance runs in date order.
pettycash|description: What was bought or why cash was received (e.g. Cement for plastering).
pettycash|dr - paid by naveen (aed): What Naveen paid for the company. What the company owes him goes up.
pettycash|dr - paid by praveen (aed): What Praveen paid for the company. What the company owes him goes up.
pettycash|held (aed): Visa payments held here, added up. When the visa is completed, the total moves to General as one line for the chief accountant to send to Zoho.
pettycash|paid (aed): Money paid out of this book for a bill. Comes off the balance. Typed from the receipt.
pettycash|payments: How many payments are held for this visa. Counted by the app.
pettycash|project: The project the director's payment was for. Project expense counts it against that site.
pettycash|received (aed): Cash given to the holder of this book (a top-up). Adds to the balance.
pettycash|site: The site the spend is for (blank = office / general). Project expense counts it against that site.
pettycash|step (pick, or type a new one): Which visa step this payment is for (e.g. Medical and EID).
pettycash|steps paid: The visa steps paid for so far (entry permit, medical, Emirates ID ...). From the payments entered.
pettycash|supplier / contact: The shop or person paid. Their TRN is looked up for VAT.
pettycash|whose visa: The person the visa costs are for. One line per visa in progress.
pettycash|whose visa? (pick, or type a n: The person the visa payment is for. Pick from the list or type a new name to start one.
phone: The phone number on the record. Typed on the record.
pick at least one column: No column is ticked yet. Tick at least one dimension or measure in Columns to include, then Run.
ppe|all time: How many PPE items he has been given in all. Counted from the issue register.
ppe|item: The PPE item (coverall, safety shoes, helmet ...). Click for its stock history.
ppe|office: In hand at the office: last count + received - given from there. A dash means not counted yet.
ppe|safety shoes: In the worker grid: the date he was last given safety shoes. In Stock by size: safety shoes in hand for each size.
ppe|store: In hand at the store: last count + received - given from there. A dash means not counted yet.
ppe|total: Store + office in hand (or all sizes added up). A dash means not counted yet.
ppe|uniforms: Uniforms in hand for each size. Counted and received size by size, less what was given in that size.
ppe|worker: The worker, with ID and trade. A flag shows approved items not given yet. Click for his PPE card.
present: Workers marked Present for the whole day. Counted from the daily attendance grid; a half present and half absent is counted as Half day.
present days: Days worked in the cycle; each half day marked Present counts 0.5. Counted from the attendance grid.
projexp|book: Which petty cash book the line is in (Site, PRO, Office ...). From the petty cash register.
projexp|contract: The project's contract value. The scopes on Project payments added up.
projexp|cost (aed): The amount counted against the project for this line. Added up in the total.
projexp|cost of contract: How much of the contract value has been spent. Total cost / contract x 100.
projexp|cost split: A bar showing each kind of cost's share of the total. Colours match the column dots.
projexp|cycle: The payroll cycle (26th to 25th) the labour cost belongs to. One group per cycle.
projexp|date: The date of the order, movement or petty cash line. Only lines in the period count.
projexp|days: Paid days he was logged to this site in the cycle. Counted from the attendance.
projexp|description: The petty cash line's description. Under it: how it was tied to the project (site box or site number in the text).
projexp|from: First day of the period. Costs from this day are counted.
projexp|from store: Consumables sent from the store to the site, less returns, at the last LPO rate. Tools are not a cost.
projexp|labour: What the project's labour cost. Each worker's paid salary (OT and adjustments included) shared over the sites his paid half-days were logged to.
projexp|lpo: The purchase order number. From the LPO register.
projexp|material: The material moved. With its code and how it was priced.
projexp|materials - lpo: Purchase orders for the site, net of VAT. An order naming two sites is split equally; orders to the store count only when issued.
projexp|movement: Issued from store, moved between sites, or returned. Returns come off the cost.
projexp|ot hours: OT hours he logged at this site in the cycle. From the attendance.
projexp|petty cash: Petty cash lines with the site filled in or its number in the description. Salary and wage payments are left out.
projexp|project: The project (site code) the costs are booked to, with its plot. Click a row for the lines behind each figure.
projexp|qty: Quantity that stayed at the site. Sent less returned.
projexp|rate: The price used for the material. The last LPO rate for the item, or its list price.
projexp|received: Money received from the client. From Project payments.
projexp|supplier and items: The supplier and what was ordered. An order naming several sites is split equally between them.
projexp|to: Last day of the period. Costs up to this day are counted.
projexp|total cost: Everything the project has cost. Labour + materials - LPO + from store + petty cash.
projexp|vat (not a cost): VAT on the order. Shown but not counted, since VAT is recovered.
projexp|worker: The worker whose salary is shared to this project. From his salary card.
projpay|collected: How much of the scope has been paid. Received / contract x 100.
projpay|contract (aed): The contract value of the scope. Typed when the scope is added.
projpay|from: First day of the date range. Payments from this day are counted.
projpay|last payment: The most recent payment and its date. Shows how long since the client paid.
projpay|month: The month whose payments are shown. Pick it when Period is Month.
projpay|payments in period: Payments received in the period chosen, each with its date. From the payments on the scope.
projpay|payments received: Every payment received against the scope, with its date. Entered here or on Accounts > Bank as a receipt against the scope.
projpay|project: The project number. Its scopes are listed under it with a project total. Click for its tax invoices.
projpay|received (aed): Money received against the scope so far. All its payments added up.
projpay|received in period (aed): Money received against the scope in the period chosen. Its payments in that period added up.
projpay|received to date (aed): Money received up to the end of the period. All payments to that date added up.
projpay|remaining (aed): Contract minus received. Worked out, never typed.
projpay|remarks: A note on the scope (e.g. 10% retention pending). Typed on the scope.
projpay|scope: The part of the contract (Design & Build, Mobilization, Core & Shell, MEP ...). Each has its own value and payments.
projpay|status: Pending (nothing received), Partial, or Completed (received the full contract). Worked out from the payments.
projpay|to: Last day of the date range. Payments up to this day are counted.
projpay|year: The year whose payments are shown. Pick it when Period is Year.
purchase|amount: Qty x rate, before VAT. Added up into the order's sub total.
purchase|asked by: Who raised the request. He becomes the contact on the order unless changed.
purchase|date: The order date. Prints on the LPO. Defaults to today.
purchase|last paid: The last rate paid for this material, with date and supplier, and whether today's rate is higher or lower. From earlier orders; 'first time' if never bought.
purchase|material: The material being ordered. Prints on the LPO; picking a known one shows its last price. Comes from the ticked requests or typed.
purchase|needed by: When the site needs it. The earliest one becomes the order's delivery date.
purchase|notes: A note printed on the order (e.g. deliver to the site).
purchase|qty: Quantity to order, in the unit shown. Comes from the request; change it if ordering a different amount.
purchase|rate: Price per unit, excluding VAT. Typed from the supplier's quote.
purchase|request: The material request the line comes from. Tick lines going to one supplier, then make the order from them.
purchase|site: The site the material is for. Its plot and in-charge fill onto the order.
purchase|spec / note (optional): A small second line printed under the material on the order (e.g. priced by the week, 'Double washed'). Leave it empty and nothing prints.
purchase|tax %: VAT rate on the line, normally 5 (0 if no VAT). VAT = qty x rate x tax % (or 5% of the net when there is a discount).
purchase|their contact person: The person we deal with at the supplier. Prints on the order. Fills in from the supplier list; change it here for this order.
purchase|their email: The supplier's email; the order can be sent to it. Fills in from the supplier list.
purchase|their mobile: The supplier contact's mobile. Prints on the order. Fills in from the supplier list.
purchase|unit: The unit the material is ordered in. Prints on the order. Comes from the item list or request.
purchase|what for: The job the material is for. It becomes the order's job scope.
qty: How many, in the unit shown. Typed with the material.
quantity: How many, in the material's unit. Typed with the material.
remark: A free remark kept with the line. Prints with it. Typed by whoever makes the entry; optional.
remarks: A free remark kept with the line. Prints with it. Typed by whoever makes the entry; optional.
reports|absence deduction (aed): What absence cost him this cycle. Daily wage: absent days x total salary / 30. Fixed pay: (absent + leave days) x total salary / 30.
reports|absent days: Days absent on the salary card for the cycle. Each costs the day and a day's deduction (daily wage). Counted from the grid.
reports|adjusted final salary (aed): What the worker is paid. Final salary plus additions minus deductions from Salary Adjustments.
reports|adjustments: Additions and deductions for the cycle, each with its reason, in one column. Typed on Salary Adjustments.
reports|adjustments & notes: This month's adjustments for the worker, and a note for management typed beneath. The note saves as you leave the box and comes back with the cycle.
reports|basic pay (aed): The basic pay on the worker's salary card for the cycle. Comes from his basic salary on Labour master data.
reports|bh amount (aed): Holiday-hours money for the group. Worked out per worker at his own rate: total salary / 30 / 8 x BH hours.
reports|bh hours: Holiday (BH) hours added up from the attendance (or the salary cards). Paid at total salary / 30 / 8 an hour.
reports|company: The company that employs the worker. Group by it to split figures by company. From Labour master data.
reports|date: The attendance date. Group by it for a day-by-day view.
reports|days absent: Days marked Absent in the group; each half day counts 0.5. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|days friday: Days marked Friday (the old rest day) in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|days holiday: Days marked Holiday (paid) in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|days leave: Days marked Leave in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|days medical: Days marked Medical in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|days present: Days marked Present in the group; each half day counts 0.5. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|days sick: Days marked Sick in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|days sunday: Days marked Sunday (paid rest day) in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|employee name: The worker's name. Pick it to get one line per worker. From Labour master data.
reports|employee no: The worker's employee number. Pick it to get one line per worker.
reports|engineer: The site engineer the days were logged under. Group by it to see each engineer's men. From daily attendance.
reports|final salary (aed): Payable salary + OT + BH + allowances - absence deduction, rounded to whole dirhams. Before manual adjustments.
reports|final salary cost (aed): Each worker's final salary for the cycle, shared over the sites and days in this group by his share of paid days. Shows labour cost per site.
reports|friday days: Days marked Friday (the rest day on older cycles). Paid. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|headcount: How many different workers are in the group. Counted by the app.
reports|holiday days: Public or company holidays on the salary card. Paid. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|leave days: Days marked Leave on the salary card. Unpaid on a daily wage; 1/30 off a fixed salary. Counted from the grid.
reports|man-days: How many attendance rows (one per worker per day) are in the group. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|medical days: Days marked Medical on the salary card. Paid like a working day. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|month: The payroll cycle (26th to 25th), named by its ending month. Group by it for month-by-month figures.
reports|ot amount (aed): Overtime money for the group. Worked out per worker at his own rate: total salary / 30 / 8 x OT hours.
reports|ot hours: Overtime hours added up from the attendance (or the salary cards). Paid at total salary / 30 / 8 an hour.
reports|payable salary (aed): The part of his salary earned for the paid days: (present + sick + medical + Friday + Sunday + holiday days) x total salary / 30. Fixed pay is capped at the salary.
reports|present days: Days present on the salary card for the cycle. Half days count 0.5. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|sick days: Days marked Sick on the salary card. Paid like a working day. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|site: The site the days were logged to on daily attendance. Group by it to see work and cost per project.
reports|sunday days: Sundays on the salary card. A paid rest day. Counted from the attendance grid.
reports|total salary (aed): The worker's monthly salary from Labour master data (basic + allowance). Not what he is paid this cycle.
reports|trade: The worker's trade. Group by it to compare trades. From Labour master data.
requests|date: The day the goods came in. Stock is booked on this date. Defaults to today.
requests|do / invoice no: The delivery order or invoice number from the supplier's paper. Lets the office match the bill. Typed from the delivery note.
requests|supplier: Who the goods were bought from. Known suppliers fill their details in. Picked or typed on the direct purchase.
requests|type: Consumable (used up), Asset (we own it) or Rental (rented in). Decides how the store tracks it. Filled from the store item list when the material is known.
requests|unit: The unit asked in (pcs, bag, m ...). Best kept the same as the store list's unit, so stock counts stay right.
requests|what is it for?: The job the material is needed for (e.g. 1st floor slab). It goes onto the order as the job scope. Typed by whoever raises the request.
returned: How much has come back (or the day it came back). Recorded when the return is entered.
role: The role that gives this login its rights (Store keeper, Accountant ...). Admin needs none. Picked on Settings > Access.
seccheque|amount: The cheque amount in AED. Typed from the cheque.
seccheque|bank & cheque: The bank it is drawn on and the cheque number. Typed from the cheque.
seccheque|cheque date: The date written on the cheque. A guarantee is usually left undated.
seccheque|collect back after: When to ask for it back. The bell reminds a week before, on the day and every day after, until it is marked collected back. Use +3m, +6m or +1y to fill it.
seccheque|given on: The day the cheque was handed over. Typed when it is added.
seccheque|given to: Who holds the guarantee cheque (client, landlord, authority, supplier). Typed when the cheque is added.
seccheque|purpose / project: Why it was given (e.g. performance guarantee) and the project or tender it is for.
settings|by: Who took the backup. Automatic ones are taken by the system.
settings|can open: The screens this login is allowed to open. Set by its role on Settings > Access.
settings|code prefix: The letters new staff codes for this company start with (e.g. IC).
settings|date: When the backup was taken. Backups are kept on a rolling basis.
settings|full name: The company's full legal name. It prints on papers. Typed when the company is added.
settings|name: The company's full legal name. It prints on papers. Typed when the company is added.
settings|role: The login's type and rights. Changed on Settings > Access.
settings|short name: The short name used on screens and statements. Typed on the company.
settings|trn: The company's VAT number. Prints on invoices and orders.
settings|type: Automatic (taken once a day) or a manual backup. Set by how it was taken.
settings|username: The name the person signs in with. Set when the login is made.
settings|wps id: The company's WPS employer ID. Needed for salary transfer files. Typed on the company.
short: Quantity not coming back (lost or damaged). It is charged off the rental rather than returned. Typed on the return note.
sick: Workers marked Sick for the day. Sick days are paid on the labour salary card. Counted from the daily attendance grid.
site: The site (project code, e.g. 906) the line belongs to. Used to group work and cost by project. Picked or typed when the entry is made.
standing: How soon this expires: Expired, Due in 30 days, Due in 90 days or Valid. Worked out from the expiry date against today.
status: Where the entry stands now. Moves on by itself as the work is done, or when someone marks it.
still due: What has still to arrive: quantity asked for minus quantity already received. Worked out by the app.
store|amount (aed): What the material that stayed at the site cost. Quantity x rate.
store|at site / last sent: Tools and equipment: how many are at that site now. Consumables: when the site last had some, since they get used up.
store|category: The group the item belongs to (e.g. scaffolding, electrical). Used to sort the list.
store|change to: The unit the app suggests from the item's name. Tick to apply it.
store|code: The item's code on the store item list. Given when the item is added.
store|condition: The state it came back in (good, damaged ...). Typed on the return.
store|date: The day the movement or note is dated. Stock moves on this date.
store|days: How long the item has been out. Today minus the day it was given out.
store|days on rent: How long it has been on hire. Today minus taken on.
store|delivered direct (aed): Value delivered by the supplier straight to the site. Quantity x the receipt's price.
store|deliveries: How many deliveries of it were received. Counted from the store receipts.
store|driver: The driver taking the load back. Prints on the return note.
store|due back: The date the rental should go back to the supplier. Set on the item list.
store|from: Where it came from: a site, or the supplier for a direct delivery. Picked on the movement.
store|from store (aed): Value issued from the central store to the site. Quantity that stayed there x last price paid.
store|given to: Who took the material or tool at the site. Typed when it is moved.
store|hired from: The supplier the rental is hired from. Returns go back to them. Set on the item or its last receipt.
store|how many: How many are being moved, in the item's unit. Cannot be more than the place it comes from holds.
store|in central store: How many are in the central store now: everything received in, less what was sent to sites, plus returns. Worked out from the store movements.
store|last arrived: The day it was last received. From the store receipts.
store|left on rent: On rent minus returning minus short. This stays on hire after the note.
store|lines: How many materials are on the note. Counted by the app.
store|lines not priced: Lines with no price on record (no receipt, LPO or list price). They are left out of the cost until priced.
store|lost / damaged: How many have been booked lost or damaged. These will not go back to the supplier.
store|material: The material or tool, as named on the store item list. Stock, prices and reports are kept on this one name.
store|moved in (aed): Value the site received from another site. The cost moves with the goods.
store|moved out (aed): Value the site passed on to another site. Shown as a minus, so it is not counted twice.
store|name: The item's name on the store item list. Every receipt and issue uses this name.
store|needed by: When the site needs it. Past this date and not delivered, it is late.
store|net transfer (aed): Value received from other sites minus value passed on. Shows goods moved between sites.
store|note: A note for the line. On a return note it is the note number (RN-...).
store|note no: The return note number. Numbered by itself.
store|notes on the note: A note printed on the return note. Optional.
store|on hire: How many are on hire from the supplier now. Received less returned.
store|on rent: How many of this rental item are with us now. Received from the supplier, less what was returned or written off.
store|out at sites: How many are out at sites now: sent out or delivered direct, less what came back. Worked out from the movements.
store|out since: The day it last went out to this site. From the store movements.
store|qty: How many, in the unit shown. Typed on the movement.
store|qty back: How many came back. Typed on the return.
store|quantity: How many, in the item's unit. Typed with the material.
store|raised: The day the request was raised. Recorded when it was sent.
store|rate (aed): Price per unit: the receipt's cost, else the last LPO price on or before that day, else the price on the item list. Blank if none.
store|reason: Why it was lost or damaged. Typed on the entry.
store|ref: The reference on the movement (delivery note, LPO or note number). Typed on the movement.
store|remark: A remark for the line. Prints on the return note.
store|remarks: Notes on the movement, including what came back to the store. Typed on the movement or added by the app.
store|rented from: For rentals: the supplier it is hired from. A rental needs one, so it can be returned to them.
store|reported by: Who reported the loss or damage. Typed on the entry.
store|request: The material request number. Click to open it.
store|returned: Total quantity going back on the note (or the day an issued tool came back). Added up from the note's lines.
store|returned by: Who brought it back. Typed on the return.
store|returning: How many are physically going back on this note. Typed on the return note.
store|short: How many are not coming back (lost or damaged). On a return note list: the total short on that note.
store|shortfall: Warn-under level minus what the central store holds. How many to reorder to get back to the level.
store|since: The day it was given out (or first came in). Days out count from it.
store|site: The site it went to or is held at. Picked on the movement.
store|site cost (aed): What the site has used: from store + delivered direct + moved in - moved out. Only priced lines count.
store|status: Return notes: draft, issued (sent with the driver) or confirmed (signed copy back); nothing leaves the books until confirmed. Requests: where the request stands.
store|still out: How many are still out at the site. Given out minus brought back.
store|supplier: The supplier the return note goes to (or who supplied it). Picked on the note.
store|suppliers: Who supplied it. From the store receipts.
store|taken on: The day the rental first came in. Days on rent count from it.
store|to: Where it went: a site or the central store. Picked on the movement.
store|tool / equipment: The tool or piece of equipment given out. Named as on the store item list.
store|total held: Everything the company holds of the item. In central store + out at sites.
store|type: Consumable (used up on site), Asset (owned, comes back) or Rental (rented in, goes back to the supplier). Set on the item list.
store|unit: The unit the item is counted in. All stock for it is kept in this unit.
store|unit now: The unit the item is counted in today. Set on the item list.
store|vehicle: The vehicle number. Prints on the return note.
store|warn under: The reorder level. When the central store holds less than this, the item shows as low stock. Typed on the item list.
store|where it is: Where the stock sits: the central store or a site. Picked when the stock is added.
store|why: What in the item's name made the app suggest that unit. Untick the line to keep the unit as it is.
store|why short: Why the short quantity is not coming back (lost, damaged ...). Prints on the return note.
store|with: Who the tool was given to. Typed when it is given out.
store|written off: How many have been booked lost or damaged. They come off what the company holds.
supplier: The supplier the material came from or is ordered from. Their contact details fill in from the supplier list. Picked from the list or typed.
suppliers|contact: The person we deal with there. Prints on orders.
suppliers|email: Where purchase orders are emailed. Typed on the supplier.
suppliers|name: The supplier's company name. It prints on orders and links their bills. Typed once here.
suppliers|phone: The contact's phone. Prints on orders.
suppliers|terms: Payment terms (e.g. Due on Receipt). Fill onto every new order for this supplier.
suppliers|trn: The supplier's 15-digit VAT number. Prints on orders and is needed to claim VAT. Missing ones show in red.
terms: The payment terms agreed (e.g. Due on Receipt, 30 days). Print on the purchase order. Typed on the supplier record.
total: The sum of the figures on the line or in the column. Shown so the whole can be checked at a glance. Worked out by the app, never typed.
trade: The worker's trade (mason, carpenter, helper ...). Used to group and filter labour on reports. Typed on Labour master data.
trn: The 15-digit VAT Tax Registration Number. Needed on orders and to claim VAT on a bill. Typed on the supplier or company record.
type: What kind of entry or item this is. Decides how the app treats it. Picked from the list when the entry is made.
unit: The unit the material is counted in (pcs, bag, m, ton ...). Stock is kept in the store list's unit, so quantities must be in it. Set on the store item list.
username: The name typed to sign in. Must be unique. Set when the login is made.
what: What was done, in a few words. Recorded by the app automatically.
what is wrong: Why this worker's card is not ready to pay: days not marked, A.M or P.M missing, Present without site or engineer, BH without a comment. Found by the check run on the cycle.
when: The date and time it happened. Recorded by the app automatically.
who: The login that did it. Recorded by the app automatically.
zoho|amount: The line's amount in AED (+ for money received). Sent to Zoho as it is.
zoho|book: Which petty cash book the line is from (Site, PRO, Office). Filter by it with Book.
zoho|date: The date of the line. As entered where it came from.
zoho|description · supplier: What the line is for and who was paid. As entered in the petty cash book.
zoho|from: First day of the log shown. Lines sent from this day are listed.
zoho|in zoho: What Zoho made of it (expense, bill, payment ...), or the Zoho entry it was matched to. From Zoho's reply.
zoho|portal line: The line as it is in this app: date, book, description, supplier. Shows what was sent.
zoho|project: The project (site) the cost goes to in Zoho. Needed for project accounts; saved back on the petty cash line.
zoho|search: Find a line by description, account or number. Narrows the list as you type.
zoho|sent: When the line went to Zoho. Recorded by the app.
zoho|status: Ready to send, sent, or what must be fixed before it can go. Fix the item, then send.
zoho|supplier (portal): The supplier as named in this app. Linked to a Zoho vendor on the right.
zoho|to: Last day of the log shown. Lines sent up to this day are listed.
zoho|trn: The supplier's VAT number. Used to find the same vendor in Zoho.
zoho|vat: Whether the bill's VAT is claimed. Claim 5% needs a bill in the company's name and the supplier's TRN; otherwise Not claimable.
zoho|what: The item waiting for Zoho (LPO, loan, invoice, bank line ...). Click to open it where shown.
zoho|where it went in zoho: The Zoho account, vendor or project it was posted to. From Zoho's reply.
zoho|zoho account: The Zoho Books account the line is posted to. Picked by the chief accountant.
zoho|zoho vendor: The Zoho Books vendor this supplier is linked to. Bills and payments go to this vendor.
receipts|tax invoice: A tax invoice of this client with money still due. Tick it if this payment pays it (or part of it). Listed from Accounts > Invoices > Tax Invoice.
receipts|date: The tax invoice's own date. Shown so the oldest invoice is settled first.
receipts|project: The project number and name on the invoice. Picking a project at the top lists only its invoices.
receipts|invoice total: The invoice amount including VAT, as issued.
receipts|received: What earlier receipts have already brought in against this invoice.
receipts|balance due: What is still to be paid on the invoice: invoice total minus received. Worked out, never typed.
receipts|receive now: How much of this payment goes to this invoice. Ticking fills in the whole balance; type a smaller figure for a part payment. It can never be more than the balance due.
receipts|number: The receipt number (RC/26/914/01). Click it to open the printed receipt.
receipts|mode: How it was paid - bank transfer, cheque, cash, card or PDC - with the transfer or cheque reference under it.
receipts|against: The tax invoices this receipt was set against, and any advance kept over and above them.
receipts|amount: The money received on this receipt, in AED. The total at the foot leaves out cancelled receipts.
Numbered for you after the last receipt of the project (RC/26/914/01, 02 ...). Change it only if the receipt book says otherwise.
receipts|received on: The day the money came in. Printed on the receipt and used as the date of any PAID stamp it puts on an invoice.
receipts|received from (client): Pick the client: the address and TRN from their invoices fill in, and their tax invoices with money due are listed below.
receipts|payment mode: Click how the money came. Cheque and PDC ask for the cheque no., bank and cheque date; a cheque receipt prints 'valid subject to the cheque being honoured'.
receipts|note (printed): A line printed on the receipt, e.g. what the payment is for.
invoices|received: Shown on a tax invoice once a receipt is set against it: Received when paid in full, Part received when money is still due.
